title: Move record parsing into ledger/records.py
detail: The old ledger/parse.py did parsing and printing in one function.
result: parse_line and read_records live in ledger/records.py and return Record with a Decimal amount; ledger/parse.py is gone and cli.py imports records.

title: CSV export: `export --csv FILE`
detail: Header row date,account,amount,memo; one record per line in file order; amounts with two decimals; use the csv module. Add tests/test_export.py.

title: JSON export: `export --json FILE`
detail: ledger/export_json.py; a list of objects with the amount as a string.

title: `list --since DATE` shows only records on or after DATE
